GOAL: orient in repo before proposing.
READ: searched for progress tool; catalog now exposes tools.progress.append_progress.
OBSERVED: tool available; no code read yet.
NEXT: read repo structure, existing SID/RQ-VAE code, Stage3 protocol, prior round proposals/results.

GOAL: check whether parallel transport / angular direction code is already implemented.
READ: planning grep of repo for "parallel_transport", "transport", "angle".
OBSERVED: about to run.

GOAL: deliver final answer PTDIR-RQ.
READ: repo unreadable (external_directory denied), no browser; used the prompt's round history.
OBSERVED: earlier rounds improved SID diagnostics but not recall; they left the per-level-1-cell conditional P(t2|t1,h) problem intact.
REASONING: behaviour successor DIRECTION, Lorentz-parallel-transported from origin to the residual point, enters the level-2+ assignment softmax as a cosine gate. Tokens become direction sectors aligned across cells, so Stage-3 can pool transitions for rare t1; removing behaviour (zero field) or geometry (flat cosine) changes the token ids, so coupling is real.
COST: ~2.4e10 extra flops over 72000 Stage-2 steps (~1-3% wall clock), Stage-3 unchanged.
STATUS: full answer printed in the response; no ablation trained, all three switches exist in code.
